# Demand Responsive Transportation Services

This sandbox feature allows you to use demand responsive transportation services like Shotl.

## Contact Info

- Abel Cervantes, [abel.cervantes@shotl.com](mailto:abel.cervantes@shotl.com)

## Configuration

In order enable this feature, add a new section `demandResponsiveTransportationServices` in `router-config.json`.

The supported demand responsive transportation providers are listed below.
